_form: Form 1040 - U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
_notes: Field mappings verified by filling and visually inspecting the 2025 IRS fillable PDF. Root prefix for Page 1: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0], Page 2: topmostSubform[0].Page2[0].

_FILING_STATUS.c1_5[0]: Filing status checkbox group. /1 = Single, use Checkbox_ReadOrder for MFJ/MFS/HOH/QSS

_DEPENDENTS.Row5[0].Dependent1[0].c1_13[0]: Dependent 1 credit for other dependents checkbox (/1)

_PAGE_1_INCOME.f1_47[0]: Line 1a - Wages, salaries, tips (W-2 box 1 total)
_PAGE_1_INCOME.f1_59[0]: Line 2b - Taxable interest (from Schedule B line 4)
_PAGE_1_INCOME.f1_61[0]: Line 3b - Ordinary dividends (from Schedule B line 6)
_PAGE_1_INCOME.c1_38[0]: Line 5b checkbox - Rollover (/1 if all nontaxable rollover)
_PAGE_1_INCOME.f1_70[0]: Line 7 - Capital gain or loss (from Schedule D line 21 or line 16)

_PAGE_2_TAX_AND_CREDITS.f2_02[0]: Line 12 - Standard deduction or itemized deductions (Schedule A line 17)
_PAGE_2_TAX_AND_CREDITS.f2_05[0]: Line 13 - Total deductions (line 12 + line 12a QBI if any)
_PAGE_2_TAX_AND_CREDITS.f2_08[0]: Line 16 - Tax (from Tax Table, QD worksheet, or Schedule D worksheet)
_PAGE_2_TAX_AND_CREDITS.f2_10[0]: Line 18 - Total (line 16 + line 17 Schedule 2 Part I)

_PAGE_2_PAYMENTS.f2_17[0]: Line 25a - Federal income tax withheld from W-2s
_PAGE_2_PAYMENTS.f2_35[0]: Line 37 - Amount you owe (if tax > payments)
